title: Agent tools and execution environments
routing: Is this about the tools Foundry's own agents use and where their code runs: ToolRegistry (register, summary, byKind, allByKind), CapabilityGate with BROWSER_POLICY or RESTRICTED_POLICY and capabilities like exec:shell or browser:execute, the tool adapters (BashShell, JustBashShell, BunScript, HttpApi, PlaywrightBrowser, MemoryToolAdapter), an agent's executionEnv (bash, just-bash, typescript, browser, hybrid) and browser mode (playwright-mcp, js-execute, hybrid), output filters (rtk, compose, OutputFilter), or native tool-name helpers (toolCapability, toolGlobMatcher, LINEAR_ISSUE_TOOLS, DEFAULT_CONSUMED_TOOLS, workItemId, createNativeToolProjector)? Plain jobs: give an agent a shell, a sandbox, a browser or an HTTP client, run agent-written code safely, ask a human before a risky action, cut noisy command output, let an agent search memory mid-task, tell which capability a tool call uses.
